raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

The Mooncake direct linker loads an L3 hit with one synchronous `batch_get_into_multi_buffer_ranges` call per layer per pool, on a single thread. Each ranged op costs roughly 3 us serialized, so a DSA page-layer (a 72 KB KV range plus an 8 KB indexer range) moves at about 12-14 GB/s per rank, well below the NIC line rate. With a short new suffix on a long cached prefix (the common multi-turn / agentic shape) the load cannot hide behind compute, so it is directly on TTFT.

A standalone Mooncake microbenchmark with the GLM-5.2 page geometry (64K tokens, 6.6 GB, one GPU and its PIX NIC) shows where the time goes:

| read pattern | time | GB/s |
|---|---|---|
| one call per layer (current) | 454 ms | 14.5 |
| one call per layer, keys split over 4 threads | 188 ms | 35.0 |
| one call per page (all layers), 8 threads | 137 ms | 47.8 |

Concurrency is the main lever; reading several layers of a page per call adds more on top.

## Modifications

- `load_layer_wise` reads `linker_load_layer_group` layers per call (default 8) and splits each call's keys over `linker_load_threads` workers (default 4). All groups are submitted up front; layers are still published to `LayerWiseLoadCounter` in order, group by group, so the forward keeps overlapping with later groups.
- On failure, reads not yet started are cancelled and in-flight reads are awaited before `batch_get_session_end`, since they still write into device rows.
- Both knobs are read from `--hicache-storage-backend-extra-config`; `{"linker_load_layer_group": 1, "linker_load_threads": 1}` reproduces the previous request pattern.

The UMBP direct linker already groups layers per call (`UMBP_LAYER_GROUP`, default 8); this brings the Mooncake linker to the same shape.

## Speed Tests

GLM-5.2-FP8, 8xH200, TP8, page 64, Mooncake RDMA store on the same node over 8 NICs. L3-hit TTFT (median of 3, ms), prefix flushed from device before each measurement, `cached_tokens` checked on every request. G = layers per call, T = threads; G1/T1 is the previous behavior.

Short suffix (prefix + 64 new tokens):

| prefix | device hit | G1/T1 | G1/T4 | G4/T4 | **G8/T4** | G78/T4 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 8K | 43 | 97 | 90 | 72 | **65** | 84 |
| 32K | 53 | 209 | 218 | 182 | **175** | 224 |
| 64K | 66 | 384 | 427 | 318 | **315** | 414 |

Same, with `--enable-linker-mla-dedup`:

| prefix | device hit | G1/T1 | G1/T4 | G4/T4 | **G8/T4** | G78/T4 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 8K | 43 | 101 | 107 | 90 | **84** | 94 |
| 32K | 52 | 211 | 229 | 164 | **158** | 200 |
| 64K | 67 | 395 | 440 | 303 | **263** | 352 |

Long suffix (prefix + 8192 new tokens), with dedup: 32K 257 -> 177 ms, 64K 431 -> 283 ms (G8/T4).

Without dedup, all 8 ranks read the same replicated MLA pages and the store's aggregate bandwidth becomes the limit, so the gain is smaller; with dedup a single reader benefits fully. Threads without grouping (G1/T4) are slower than the baseline at TP8, and loading the whole page in one call (G78) gives up the layer overlap, which is why G8/T4 is the default.

## Accuracy Tests

- `test_unified_cache_linker_kl_inkling.py` (bit-exact, threshold 1e-9), `test_unified_cache_linker_kl_glm52.py` and `test_unified_cache_linker_kl_dsv4.py` pass with the new defaults.
- The GLM-5.2 and DSV4 KL tests do not notice a few misplaced distant prefix pages (a page-rotation mutation still passes them), so they were rerun with the destination rows filled with `0xA5` before each load:

| model | poisoned, this PR | poisoned, last layer group skipped |
|---|---|---|
| GLM-5.2-FP8 | pass (avg KL 0.0094) | fail (avg KL 0.206 > 0.03) |
| DeepSeek-V4-Flash-FP8 | pass (avg KL 0.0032 / 0.0054 / 0.0021) | fail (avg KL 8.56 > 0.01) |

- New unit test `test_mooncake_direct_linker_load.py` covers range merging per key, in-order layer publication when later groups finish first, and session end after in-flight reads on failure; each test fails under a matching mutation of the implementation.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

Related: #38639 (page-wise Mooncake loads behind an object-count threshold, plus ReadPlan and metrics).

+"""Unit tests for the Mooncake direct linker's grouped, concurrent layer loads."""
+
+import threading
+import time
+import unittest
+from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
+
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.hicache_storage import PoolName, PoolTransfer
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.storage.mooncake_store.mooncake_direct_linker import (
+    MooncakeDirectLinker,
+)
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.unified_cache.unified_cache_linker import (
+    LayerWiseLoadCounter,
+)
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+SLICE = 10
+
+
+class FakePool:
+    def __init__(self, skip_layers=()):
+        self.skip_layers = set(skip_layers)
+
+    def prepare_locations(self, host_indices):
+        return list(host_indices)
+
+    def get_prepared_layer_range_meta(self, locations, layer):
+        if layer in self.skip_layers:
+            return None
+        ptrs = [[(row, layer)] for row in locations]
+        sizes = [[SLICE] for _ in locations]
+        offsets = [[layer * SLICE] for _ in locations]
+        return ptrs, sizes, offsets
+
+
+class FakeStore:
+    def __init__(self, delay=None, fail_key=None):
+        self.delay = delay or (lambda keys: 0)
+        self.fail_key = fail_key
+        self.lock = threading.Lock()
+        self.ranges = []
+        self.calls = []
+        self.events = []
+
+    def batch_get_session_start(self, keys):
+        return [0] * len(keys)
+
+    def batch_get_session_end(self, keys):
+        with self.lock:
+            self.events.append(("end", time.monotonic()))
+
+    def batch_get_into_multi_buffer_ranges(self, keys, ptrs, sizes, offsets):
+        time.sleep(self.delay(keys))
+        with self.lock:
+            self.calls.append(list(keys))
+            for key, key_ptrs, key_offsets in zip(keys, ptrs, offsets):
+                for ptr, offset in zip(key_ptrs, key_offsets):
+                    self.ranges.append((key, ptr, offset))
+            self.events.append(("get", time.monotonic()))
+        if self.fail_key in keys:
+            return [0] * len(keys)
+        return [sum(item) for item in sizes]
+
+
+class FakeStorage:
+    def __init__(self, store):
+        self.store = store
+
+    def _get_hybrid_page_component_keys(self, keys, transfer):
+        return keys, None
+
+    def _tag_keys(self, keys):
+        return keys
+
+
+class RecordingCounter(LayerWiseLoadCounter):
+    def __init__(self, num_layers):
+        super().__init__(num_layers)
+        self.order = []
+
+    def complete(self, index, layer):
+        self.order.append(layer)
+        super().complete(index, layer)
+
+
+def make_linker(store, *, num_layers, layer_group, threads, pools):
+    linker = object.__new__(MooncakeDirectLinker)
+    linker.num_layers = num_layers
+    linker.load_layer_group = layer_group
+    linker.load_threads = threads
+    linker.load_io_executor = ThreadPoolExecutor(threads)
+    linker.pools = pools
+    linker.storage = FakeStorage(store)
+    linker.layer_done_counter = RecordingCounter(num_layers)
+    return linker
+
+
+def transfer(name, keys):
+    return PoolTransfer(name=name, keys=keys, host_indices=list(range(len(keys))))
+
+
+def load(linker, request_transfers):
+    index = linker.layer_done_counter.update_producer()
+    linker.load_layer_wise(index, request_transfers)
+    return index
+
+
+class TestGroupedLoad(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_every_layer_range_is_read_once_per_key(self):
+        store = FakeStore()
+        linker = make_linker(
+            store,
+            num_layers=5,
+            layer_group=2,
+            threads=2,
+            pools={PoolName.KV: FakePool(), PoolName.INDEXER: FakePool({1, 2})},
+        )
+        keys = [f"k{i}" for i in range(3)]
+        index = load(
+            linker,
+            [[transfer(PoolName.KV, keys), transfer(PoolName.INDEXER, keys[:2])]],
+        )
+        self.assertTrue(linker.layer_done_counter.finish(index))
+        expected = [
+            (key, (row, layer), layer * SLICE)
+            for row, key in enumerate(keys)
+            for layer in range(5)
+        ] + [
+            (key, (row, layer), layer * SLICE)
+            for row, key in enumerate(keys[:2])
+            for layer in (0, 3, 4)
+        ]
+        self.assertCountEqual(store.ranges, expected)
+        # Groups of two layers carry two ranges per key; keys split over two threads.
+        self.assertTrue(all(len(call) <= 2 for call in store.calls))
+        self.assertEqual(linker.layer_done_counter.order, [0, 1, 2, 3, 4])
+
+    def test_layers_complete_in_order_when_later_groups_finish_first(self):
+        store = FakeStore(delay=lambda keys: 0.05 if keys == ["k0"] else 0)
+        linker = make_linker(
+            store,
+            num_layers=4,
+            layer_group=1,
+            threads=4,
+            pools={PoolName.KV: FakePool()},
+        )
+        index = load(linker, [[transfer(PoolName.KV, ["k0"])]])
+        self.assertTrue(linker.layer_done_counter.finish(index))
+        self.assertEqual(linker.layer_done_counter.order, [0, 1, 2, 3])
+
+    def test_failure_ends_sessions_after_inflight_reads(self):
+        store = FakeStore(
+            delay=lambda keys: 0.2 if keys == ["slow"] else 0, fail_key="bad"
+        )
+        linker = make_linker(
+            store,
+            num_layers=1,
+            layer_group=1,
+            threads=2,
+            pools={PoolName.KV: FakePool()},
+        )
+        index = load(linker, [[transfer(PoolName.KV, ["bad", "slow"])]])
+        self.assertFalse(linker.layer_done_counter.finish(index))
+        self.assertEqual(linker.layer_done_counter.order, [])
+        linker.load_io_executor.shutdown(wait=True)
+        last_get = max(t for kind, t in store.events if kind == "get")
+        first_end = min(t for kind, t in store.events if kind == "end")
+        self.assertGreater(first_end, last_get)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
